name: Write final CSV map
instructions: Write the final app-loadable CSV to maps/<mapName>.csv.
Use one quoted CSV cell per map tile.
Every tile value must use the app-compatible format: <asset type>, <damage>, <variant>.
Use default damage D99 and default variant 001 unless the map request or asset catalog specifies otherwise.
Do not include intermediate labels such as M, A, B, H, #, ?, or . in the final CSV.
Do not write floorplan drafts or wall drafts into maps/. Those belong in mapgen/intermediate/.
Final CSV rows may be ragged only when the generated map shape is intentionally ragged and all border/enclosure validations pass.
Do not overwrite unrelated maps unless the user explicitly asks.
